prepare.rationale: First-party setup that installs the repository's reviewed Git hooks; the hardened root install opts into it explicitly after dependency rebuilds.

node_modules/@prisma/client@5.22.0.rationale: Prisma Client postinstall prepares its generated client fallback; application schema generation remains an explicit separate command.

node_modules/@prisma/engines@5.22.0.rationale: Prisma validates and prepares the platform-specific query engines required by backend tooling.

node_modules/cpu-features@0.0.10.rationale: Optional native CPU feature detection requires a platform build on supported developer and CI hosts.

node_modules/fsevents@2.3.3.rationale: Optional macOS filesystem event bindings require platform installation and must not be disabled without macOS coverage.

node_modules/msgpackr-extract@3.0.4.rationale: Optional native MessagePack acceleration selects or builds a platform binary during installation.

node_modules/prisma@5.22.0.rationale: The Prisma CLI performs a supported-platform preinstall check needed before explicit prisma generate invocations.

node_modules/protobufjs@7.6.5.rationale: The protobufjs postinstall only prints a project support message and is not required for generated runtime artifacts.

node_modules/ssh2@1.17.0.rationale: SSH2 may build its optional native crypto binding and needs platform coverage before that install path can be denied.

node_modules/fsevents@2.3.2.rationale: Optional macOS filesystem event bindings require platform installation and must not be disabled without macOS coverage.

node_modules/unrs-resolver@1.11.1.rationale: The resolver validates its N-API platform binding for the frontend build toolchain.

node_modules/vite/node_modules/fsevents@.rationale: Vite's optional macOS filesystem event binding requires platform installation and must not be disabled without macOS coverage.

node_modules/electron@41.10.3.rationale: Electron installs the pinned runtime binary required to run and package the desktop application.

node_modules/electron-winstaller@5.4.0.rationale: The Windows installer tooling selects the bundled 7-Zip executable for the current architecture.

node_modules/esbuild@0.28.1.rationale: tsx depends on esbuild verifying and linking its platform-specific executable.

node_modules/fsevents@2.3.3.rationale: Optional macOS filesystem event bindings require platform installation and must not be disabled without macOS coverage.
